title: Litoral — a quiet house above the water
desc: Eleven rooms on a lime-washed terrace in Cala Blanca. One olive tree, and the sea doing the talking.

hero.title: A quiet house above the water
hero.lead: Eleven rooms on a lime-washed terrace in Cala Blanca. One olive tree, breakfast late, and the afternoon entirely yours.

args.title: Built for the hours nobody schedules
body: The terrace was laid in 1974 and has been re-limed every spring since. Nothing about it has been modernised for the sake of it.
Doors stay open from May. The olive tree is older than the house and the shade it throws is the reason most of the chairs face the way they do.

args.heading: Three ways to stay
args.sub: Every room opens onto the terrace or the water. None of them have a television.

items.title: Terrace
items.caption: Shuttered doors onto the pool deck, and the olive tree for shade.

items.title: Garden
items.caption: Rosemary under the window, quietest of the three at night.

items.title: Sea View
items.caption: Two windows facing east. The light arrives before you do.

items.title: The Long Room
items.caption: Under the eaves, for anyone staying more than a week.

items.title: Breakfast is late
items.body: Served from nine until it stops. Bread from the village, tomatoes from the terrace, coffee for as long as you sit there.

items.title: Lunch is whatever came in
items.body: One plate, decided at the market. If the boats had a poor morning, it is vegetables, and it is still good.

items.title: Dinner is at eight
items.body: Six tables under the tree. Guests eat together unless they would rather not, which is also fine.

items.a: Two nights, and three over the August weekends. Off season, one night is fine.
Yes, in the Garden and Terrace rooms. There is a bowl by the door already.
Forty minutes from the airport. We will send a car if you tell us the flight.

args.title: Come in the shoulder season
args.sub: May and late September are the best of it — warm water, no queue for the table.

footer.tagline: Cala Blanca · a quiet house above the water
